measurement_note: Size S is the caption length. Legal tiers 16, 64, and 150 span more than 9x. Each workload alternates one-letter words with spaces, so the tag remains below its 100-character cap and the accepted state machine scans all S characters in O(S). A correct calibrated alternative repeatedly scans the preceding caption prefix to classify every letter, taking O(S^2); it must pass all outputs and fail only the scaling verdict.
